field.headless.label: Run headless
field.headless.help: With this on there is no visible browser window, which suits unattended use; turn it off to watch what it clicks (applies after the browser restarts).
field.executablePath.label: Browser executable
field.executablePath.help: Probing order: Chrome in Program Files → Edge in Program Files(x86) → Edge in Program Files → Chrome / Edge in %LOCALAPPDATA%.
field.probe.label: Current probe result
field.probe.missing: No Chrome or Edge found (fill in the path above)
field.profileDir.label: Profile directory
field.profileDir.placeholder: Empty = a temporary directory per launch, deleted on exit
field.profileDir.help: Leaving it empty is cleanest. With a fixed directory, cleanup is yours; never point it at your everyday browser profile (Chrome 136+ silently ignores remote debugging there).
field.allowedDomains.label: Domain rules (allow / !deny)
field.allowedDomains.help: Comma separated. Plain entries form the allowlist (once set, only they can open); entries starting with `!` are the denylist (for example !bad.com). Cloud metadata and private addresses are always refused.
field.maxSnapshotChars.label: Snapshot character limit
field.maxSnapshotChars.help: Truncated by line, never splitting an element in half; longer output is written to disk by the spill plugin.
field.dialogPolicy.label: Dialog policy
option.dialog.must-respond: Report to the model and wait for it (default)
field.dialogPolicy.help: What happens when a page raises alert/confirm/prompt. Under must_respond an unanswered dialog blocks commands for that page and is dismissed after 300 seconds.
field.enableEvaluate.label: Allow running JS in the page
field.enableEvaluate.help: With this on the model can evaluate arbitrary JS expressions in the page (sensitive primitives and embedded addresses are still blocked). With it off, browser action=evaluate and the guard both refuse; snapshots, clicks and typing are unaffected.
field.downloadDir.label: Download directory
field.downloadDir.placeholder: Empty = the browser's default download directory
field.downloadDir.help: Downloaded files land here; if empty they go to the temporary profile and vanish when the browser closes.
field.waitTimeoutMs.label: Interactive wait limit
field.waitTimeoutMs.help: In milliseconds. This is a simplified wait (it only checks whether a box can be computed), not Playwright-grade actionability.
field.consoleBuffer.label: Console buffer lines
field.networkBuffer.label: Network buffer lines
field.state.label: Current state
field.state.stopped: Not running (it starts automatically on the first tool call)
field.lookTab.label: Show current tab
field.lookTab.help: Read the URL and title of the current tab; if the browser is not running it starts it.
field.closeBrowser.label: Close browser
field.closeBrowser.help: Kill the whole process tree and delete the self-made profile (a profile directory you configured is kept).
save.notNumberSnapshot: The snapshot character limit must be a number.
save.badDialogPolicy: The dialog policy must be must_respond, auto_dismiss or auto_accept.
save.notNumberWait: The interactive wait limit must be a number.
save.notNumberConsole: The console buffer size must be a number.
save.notNumberNetwork: The network buffer size must be a number.
save.unknownKey: This section has no such setting: {key}
action.notRunning: The controlled browser is not running.
action.closed: Closed the controlled browser (whole process tree killed).
action.closedProfile: Closed the controlled browser (whole process tree killed; the self-made profile {profile} was deleted).
action.lookFailed: Could not read the current tab: {message}
